status: Recorded before v3 acoustic development scoring
selection: Rank candidates using mean SI-SDRi across target-present acoustic development conditions; inspect ESTOI, confusion and absence suppression separately. Prefer candidates retaining clean quality. No single metric establishes perceived static.
fallback: If no candidate meets all gates, preserve v0.2.0 as default and expose experimental comparisons with their failures. Do not silently lower gates after scoring.
listening: Blind A/B form with separate 1..5 ratings: competing speech, target damage, static. If no human ratings arrive, explicitly report subjective assessment as pending.
new_test: Bind selected checkpoint, source, cases and acoustic hashes before evaluation; the test cannot determine model selection.
